description: Browse previously published and validated insurance formula archives, with exact formula IDs, conditions, source excerpts, last real review dates and edition provenance. Start without arguments for an index, then select panel_id and optionally formula_id. These are historical documentary facts only, not current offers, ranking, prices, eligibility or personal coverage. An expired review does not erase previously verified facts; corrupt or never-approved editions remain excluded.

formula_id.description: Exact formula ID from a selected historical panel.

panel_id.description: Exact historical panel ID returned by the index.

name: get_historical_formula_archive
